headline: Colombia Fiscal Rescue Bill Aims to Raise 80 Trillion Pesos by 2030
summary: Colombia's proposed Fiscal Rescue Law aims to collect nearly 80 trillion pesos by 2030 through expenditure cuts, tax increases, and asset sales. Analysts note the measure represents significant fiscal adjustment despite missing initial targets.
why: Colombia's government is seeking to reduce public sector deficit ratios and stabilize sovereign debt obligations.
